summary:
The 11 Days in Turkey Tour takes a historical route from Istanbul to the Aegean before finishing among the distinctive landscapes of Cappadocia. Visit the Gallipoli battlefields and ancient Troy, explore the hilltop remains of Pergamon and walk through Ephesus before reaching Pamukkale and nearby Hierapolis. The final part of the journey brings a complete change of scenery, with Cappadocia’s valleys, fairy chimneys and rock-cut settlements.
This itinerary runs throughout the year, with departure dates chosen around your travel plans. We arrange selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, two domestic flights, airport transfers and the guided sightseeing scheduled during the journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar and enjoy a scenic cruise along the Bosphorus. After the tour, transfer to the airport for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, meet and transfer to your hotel in Cappadocia. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia Tour & Flight to Izmir
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. After the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir at 22:50. Upon arrival at 00:20, meet and transfer to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Ephesus Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the world. Enter through the Magnesia Gate and walk past remarkable landmarks including the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the impressive Great Theatre, where Saint Paul once preached. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. After lunch, visit the sacred House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi

itinerary.title: Day trip to Pamukkale & Hierapolis
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the famous Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, drive back to Kusadasi. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Priene, Miletus & Didyma Day tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Priene, one of the ancient Ionian cities. Continue to Miletus to explore its impressive theatre and Byzantine fortress, then visit Didyma, home to the magnificent Temple of Apollo and the famous fallen head of Medusa. After the tour, return to your hotel. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pergamon Tour & Transfer to Canakkale
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, depart for Pergamon and explore its impressive Acropolis, including the Temple of Athena, ancient Library, Altar of Zeus, Temple of Trajan, and the world’s steepest ancient theatre. Enjoy views of the Red Basilica before lunch in town. After the tour, continue to Canakkale. Overnight in Canakkale.

itinerary.title: Day trip Troy, Gallipoli & Istanbul
itinerary.text: Visit the ancient city of Troy, including the famous Trojan Horse, city walls, Temple of Athena, Roman Baths, and Odeon. Continue to Eceabat for lunch before the guided Gallipoli campaign Battlefields Tour, visiting Anzac Cove, Lone Pine Memorial, The Nek, and Chunuk Bair. After the tour, transfer to Istanbul. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 11-Day Turkey Tour Package?
faqs.a: The 11-Day Turkey Tour Package covers Istanbul, Gallipoli, Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, visit the famous battlefields of Gallipoli, discover the legendary city of Troy, tour the ancient Acropolis of Pergamon, walk through the remarkable ruins of Ephesus, experience Pamukkale's white travertine terraces, and explore the unique landscapes of Cappadocia. The tour runs for 10 nights and 11 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 11-Day Turkey Tour Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,975 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, hotel category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights. These flights help reduce travel time between regions and allow you to comfortably experience Turkey's most important historical, cultural, and natural attractions.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 10 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are selected for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions. All airport and hotel transfers throughout the itinerary are included.

faqs.q: Does the 11-day Turkey tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled sightseeing tours. As part of the small-group experience, your guide will provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience Turkey's most important highlights in one journey. It combines ancient cities, World War I history, natural wonders, and unique landscapes, offering a comprehensive introduction to the country.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Sites such as Gallipoli, Troy, Pergamon, Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia involve moderate walking, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be arranged as an optional activity. Since balloon flights are weather-dependent and highly popular, advance reservations are strongly recommended.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 11-Day Turkey Tour Package?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 11-Day Turkey Tour Package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include optional excursions, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
